input.summary: Add a Licensee right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
input.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month Initial Period gives us no exit right while Licensor may terminate immediately in several circumstances, so we have added a Licensee termination-for-convenience right on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. If Licensor needs more runway, we can accept 60-90 days' notice and an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.text: IV Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Licensee may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience and without cause or penalty upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any fees prepaid for the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.
